parameter_semantics: target_object selects the currently observed red_pose as intended pickup/manipulation frame; destination selects observed red_goal in world metres; handoff_object selects blue_pose and blue_goal for predecessor release. Poses are world metres and wxyz and are resolved causally. Values are scene identifiers, not actuator commands.
output_semantics: Each slot is [x,y,z metres, rotation-6D, gripper scalar] for a TCP pose in the causally selected active-object frame. The active frame is blue when its 3D TCP distance is strictly less than red's, otherwise red; labels select from each pre-action observation and decoding selects from the fresh current observation. Rotation-6D is projected by Gram-Schmidt, the relative transform is composed into world, and supplied Panda IK converts it from freshly measured joints. Slot 0 represents t-1 and execution uses slots 1..8 for t..t+7. Gripper values preserve native sign semantics.

conversion_check.description: Compare decoded IK FK TCP to the demonstrated commanded TCP after active-object relative pose roundtrip; report metres, radians, gripper error and IK diagnostics. Gram-Schmidt is the only rotation projection.

cut_relation: Covers every assigned [start,stop) action in all 12 segments. It preserves the roughly 230-240 action place_blue overlap: blue lowering/opening and retreat are blue-relative, followed by transit, red approach/closure and initial lift, then full red placement and terminal retreat.
